absorbedFacts: Past numbers, streaks, hot/cold numbers and Martingale-style progressions do not create positive expectation on an independently generated fair wheel.
families.researchUse: Use spin history only for testing reproducible implementation bias, never pattern-chasing.

sources.finding: Small and Tse demonstrate that initial wheel/ball position, velocity and acceleration can make a casino-grade physical roulette outcome predictively exploitable in experimental conditions; reported expected return at least 18% in one implemented system.
Earlier implemented image-processing/data-analysis system on a casino-grade wheel reported expected return above 40% in the experiment.

families.onlineGuard: A physical result model is useless if the operator closes bets before enough post-release motion is observable and actionable after stream/action latency.

sources.finding: Long random sequences naturally contain streaks; roulette systems can look compelling in-sample even when the wheel is fair. True mechanical bias is a distinct empirical question.

A study recorded 10,980 spins from a real online live European roulette wheel and used backtesting/walk-forward methods to investigate bias/profitability; useful as methodology, not proof for any current table.
Evolution selects one to five Lucky Numbers and 50x-500x payouts after betting time has ended; ordinary non-multiplied Straight Up wins pay 29:1, other standard bets keep standard roulette payouts.

William Hill Spain publishes 97.10% optimal theoretical RTP for Straight Up and 97.30% for other wagers in First Person Lightning Roulette.
A creator markets a 'best strategy' around a big multiplier win. Outcome/sponsorship content is not evidence of positive EV.

Public review/strategy video retained for interface/mechanic discovery only.

Video shows a jackpot outcome; retained as visual feature discovery only, never positive-EV evidence.

Betfair Spain publicly displays a current Age of the Gods jackpot amount on the original network slot; public page values are snapshot candidates and must be exact-time/network-bound before analysis.
